Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The bedroom - Day

[Ayaan stands in the bedroom. Anita stands near him.]

Ayaan: "What lovely weather!"

[Ayaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Anita: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Anita: "What a day to remember!"
